rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a careful examination or inspection.

example.english: I need to go for a medical inspection tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我聽日要去做身體檢查。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 zou6 san1 tai2 gim2 caa4

rows.note: Use this for an official inspection authority or body that checks compliance with rules.

example.english: The customs inspection team came to inspect the goods today.
example.jyutping: hoi2 gwaan1 kai1 caa4 gam1 jat6 lai4 caa4 fo3
